Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator

Class OlgaTableGrid

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator.OlgaTableGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
final class OlgaTableGrid extends Object implements Serializable
One axis of an OLGA property table grid: a range or an explicit list, with optional phase-envelope refinement and insertion of the standard-condition value.

Envelope refinement: when the envelope maximum along the axis (cricondenbar for pressure, cricondentherm for temperature) lies inside the range, a share gridFactor/(gridFactor+1) of the points is placed inside the envelope and the rest outside, each part equidistant. Otherwise the axis stays equidistant. When the standard value lies inside the range and is not a node, the axis is rebuilt with one point fewer and the standard value is inserted, so the point count is unchanged.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
